description:
The user answered fz-9e2.3's design question (relayed by Binary Handling on 2026-11-19): fix it generally. Owner: Binary Handling. A page comes before any build.

## Why
#806 (fz-9e2.3) shows proven constructions costing about 9 instructions more per iteration (probes 04b, 05a, 06a, 06b). The failure call's result joins the success value. __construction_failed__ already declares :: never, so its delivery can never reach the join. The same applies to case ... -> raise arms (not yet probed).

## Done when
A call whose @spec returns never contributes no source to a join, on all three paths. #806's +9 instructions per iteration is gone on the bench. The cost in jobs and pins is measured.

## Coordinate
fz-bpd (Bugs and Cleanup, page /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-bpd.html) changes how a join's deliverers are read: ResumePayload from value_origin via body.rs delivered_value_joins. This ticket edits the same deliverer set, so it builds on fz-bpd's answer.
title: A value delivered by a call whose spec is never is not a join source
